bio: Elaine Goodman Luria (; LUUR-ee-ə; born August 15, 1975) is an American politician and US Navy veteran who served as the U.S. representative from Virginia's 2nd congressional district from 2019 to 2023. A member of the Democratic Party, Luria is set to return to her old seat after winning the 2026 election in a rematch against Republican incumbent Jen Kiggans, who defeated her in 2022.
